item.title: Automated Decision Support Framework for IoT: Towards a Cyber Physical Recommendation System
item.description: Abstract # Among the key factors of Industry 4.0 are the intensive use of Cyber Physical Systems (CPSs). These systems can be implemented at many application levels for various application domains. Each application requires a personalized CPS architecture concerning the Physical sensors as well as the management of Cyber systems. Furthermore, it requires also the maintenance of the communications among these different sub-systems. However, researchers and engineers may lack the essential knowledge to design and build an autonomous CPS.
